en.headline: Election Committee nomination opens on Wednesday
en.dek: The Electoral Affairs Commission chairman said preparations are ready as the subsector nomination period runs from 7 to 20 October.
body: Nomination for the 2026 Election Committee subsector ordinary election opens on Wednesday and runs until 20 October, with polling day set for Sunday 22 November.

Electoral Affairs Commission chairman Mr Justice David Lok visited the returning officers' office at the Central Government Offices in Tamar on Tuesday to see how nomination forms will be received and to inspect the venue. He said preparations for the nomination period were ready, and that staff would follow the set procedures so the opening on Wednesday runs smoothly.

A candidate must be a registered geographical constituency elector aged 18 or above, and must be a registered voter of the relevant subsector or have a substantial connection with it. A nomination form must be signed by at least five registered voters of that subsector. Each voter may nominate no more candidates than the number of committee members the subsector is to return. A corporate voter may nominate only through its authorised representative.
Nomination forms can be collected at the Registration and Electoral Office, at the relevant returning officers' offices, and at district offices during office hours.

zh.headline: 選委會界別分組選舉提名期周三展開
zh.dek: 選管會主席陸啟康視察添馬選舉主任辦事處，稱提名期安排已準備就緒；提名由周三起至10月20日。
body: 2026年選舉委員會界別分組一般選舉將於11月22日（星期日）舉行，提名期由周三（10月7日）開始，至10月20日結束。
選舉管理委員會主席陸啟康周二到訪位於添馬政府總部的選舉主任辦事處，了解接收提名表格的流程，並視察場地。他表示，辦事處就提名期的籌備工作和各項安排已準備就緒，工作人員會按程序接收表格，確保周三展開的提名期運作暢順。
獲提名的人須年滿18歲、已登記為地方選區選民，並已登記為有關界別分組的投票人，或與該界別分組有密切聯繫。提名表格須至少由五名已登記為該界別分組的投票人簽署。每名投票人可提名的候選人數目，不得超過該界別分組須選出的選委會委員數目。團體投票人只可經獲授權代表作出提名。
提名表格可在選舉事務處辦事處、有關界別分組的選舉主任辦事處索取，亦可於各區民政事務處辦公時間內索取。
